catalog.check.design.tokens.static.title: Static design-token conformance
catalog.check.design.tokens.static.why: Literal values outside the scale silently break consistency.
catalog.check.design.tokens.static.limit: It does not see values generated at runtime, and it does not read a Tailwind 3 configuration written in JavaScript.
catalog.check.design.tokens.render.title: Rendered value conformance
catalog.check.design.tokens.render.why: What is rendered can differ from what is written.
catalog.check.design.tokens.render.limit: It samples elements, not every pixel, and cannot measure conformance without an expected value.
catalog.check.design.fonts.static.title: Static fonts
catalog.check.design.fonts.static.why: A silent fallback font changes the identity and the reading.
catalog.check.design.fonts.static.limits: It does not judge how a font looks.
catalog.check.design.fonts.render.title: Fonts actually loaded
catalog.check.design.fonts.render.why: A declared font may not load.
catalog.check.design.fonts.render.limits: System fonts affect the result when a font is missing.
catalog.check.design.a11y.title: Automated accessibility and contrast
catalog.check.design.a11y.why: An automated scan finds part of the accessibility barriers.
catalog.check.design.a11y.limits: It finds only part of the issues, may not settle contrast over images and gradients, and claims no WCAG conformance.
catalog.check.design.a11y.review.title: Human accessibility review
catalog.check.design.a11y.review.why: What a tool cannot find: the keyboard, the screen reader, and meaning.
catalog.check.design.a11y.review.limits: The quality of the review is the reviewer’s responsibility.
catalog.check.design.rtl.static.title: Static direction
catalog.check.design.rtl.static.why: Direction errors do not show with English.
catalog.check.design.rtl.static.limits: It does not judge the design, and a physical property may be intended.
catalog.check.design.rtl.render.title: Rendered direction
catalog.check.design.rtl.render.why: Overflow, clipping and visual order only show when rendered.
catalog.check.design.rtl.render.limits: Complex mixed text needs a human review, and the browser language alone is not enough.
catalog.check.design.states.title: UI states
catalog.check.design.states.why: Loading, error and empty states are the least tried.
catalog.check.design.states.limits: Simulation proves the controlled scenario, not the real service.
catalog.check.design.visual.title: Visual comparison
catalog.check.design.visual.limits: It detects difference, not ugliness, and never approves a baseline by itself.
catalog.check.sec.secrets.files.title: Secrets in files
catalog.check.sec.secrets.files.why: An exposed secret is damage that is hard to undo.
catalog.check.sec.secrets.files.limits: Patterns can be wrong and can miss, and it does not cover Git history.
catalog.check.sec.secrets.history.title: Secrets in Git history
catalog.check.sec.secrets.history.why: A secret deleted from the files stays in the history.
catalog.check.sec.secrets.history.limits: Heavy on large repositories; a shallow clone is checked only for the history it has.
catalog.check.sec.deps.title: Offline dependency vulnerabilities
catalog.check.sec.deps.why: A known vulnerability in a locked version.
catalog.check.sec.deps.limits: It does not prove exploitability and is limited by the date of the database.
catalog.check.sec.deps.audit.title: Ecosystem audit over the network
catalog.check.sec.deps.audit.why: A fallback when the offline OSV database is unavailable.
catalog.check.sec.deps.audit.limits: It sends the dependency list to the registry, and never runs together with the offline check.
catalog.check.sec.sast.title: Security patterns
catalog.check.sec.sast.why: Known dangerous patterns, such as eval of a non-constant value or shell commands built from variables.
catalog.check.sec.sast.limits: A pattern does not prove exploitation, and no alert does not prove no vulnerability.
catalog.check.sec.ext.manifest.title: Manifest validity
catalog.check.sec.ext.manifest.limits: It does not prove the extension works in the browser.
catalog.check.sec.ext.permissions.title: Permissions against the policy
catalog.check.sec.ext.permissions.why: Permissions are the basis of a user’s trust in the extension.
catalog.check.sec.ext.permissions.limits: A broad permission does not prove it is unnecessary without knowing the behavior.
catalog.check.code.build.title: Build
catalog.check.code.build.why: What does not build cannot ship.
catalog.check.code.build.limits: Building does not prove correct behavior.
catalog.check.code.types.title: Types
catalog.check.code.types.why: Type errors are found in seconds.
catalog.check.code.types.limits: A well-typed program can still compute a wrong result.
catalog.check.code.lint.title: Code rules
catalog.check.code.lint.limits: The rules are the project’s choice and AYAR adds none; a configuration error is «Unavailable», not a failure.
catalog.check.code.unused.title: Missing and unused dependencies
catalog.check.code.unused.why: A missing dependency breaks a clean install; an unused one weighs the project down.
catalog.check.code.unused.limits: Dynamic loading, generated code and missing entry points cause wrong results; nothing is deleted automatically.
catalog.check.code.refs.local.title: Local references
catalog.check.code.refs.local.why: A missing file breaks the page or the documentation.
catalog.check.code.refs.local.limits: Local only; it does not check external links.
catalog.check.code.refs.external.title: External links
catalog.check.code.refs.external.why: A dead link misleads the user.
catalog.check.code.refs.external.limits: Timeouts, blocked access and login pages are not breakage, and no credentials are sent.
catalog.check.code.size.title: Size budget
catalog.check.code.size.why: Excess size slows loading and installing.
catalog.check.code.size.limits: Size does not prove something is unused; without a budget the sizes are information only.
catalog.check.code.complexity.title: Maintainability indicators
catalog.check.code.complexity.why: An indicator of where to refactor.
catalog.check.code.complexity.limits: Not evidence of a defect; length is not complexity; it never enters the index.
catalog.check.beh.unit.title: Unit and regression tests
catalog.check.beh.unit.why: The expected behavior as the project declares it.
catalog.check.beh.unit.limits: A failure proves a broken test expectation, which may itself be wrong; passing does not prove there are no defects.
catalog.check.beh.integration.title: Integration and API
catalog.check.beh.integration.why: How the parts and services work together.
catalog.check.beh.integration.limits: Mocks do not prove the real provider, and a successful status code alone is not enough.
catalog.check.beh.e2e.title: User journeys
catalog.check.beh.e2e.why: The whole task as the user performs it.
catalog.check.beh.e2e.limits: Failures need diagnosis, and flakiness does not count.
catalog.check.beh.contract.title: Contracts
catalog.check.beh.contract.why: The agreement between consumer and provider.
catalog.check.beh.contract.limits: A contract does not prove side effects.
catalog.check.beh.ext.host.title: Extension in its host
catalog.check.beh.ext.host.why: An extension can be valid statically and fail when loaded.
catalog.check.beh.ext.host.limits: Chromium only in the first release; Firefox gets the manifest check only.
catalog.check.beh.stability.title: Test stability
catalog.check.beh.stability.why: A flaky suite loses its value.
catalog.check.beh.stability.limits: Costly, and a stable sample does not prove the absence of flakiness.
catalog.check.beh.mutation.title: Test strength
catalog.check.beh.mutation.why: Do the tests fail when the behavior breaks?
catalog.check.beh.mutation.limits: Heavy, and the score is not a general guarantee.
catalog.check.perf.web.title: Lab rendering metrics
catalog.check.perf.web.limits: The lab is not the field.
catalog.check.perf.load.title: Load
catalog.check.perf.load.why: Load errors do not show with a single user.
catalog.check.perf.load.limits: There is no universal number, and nothing is pointed at production without permission.
catalog.check.perf.recovery.title: Recovery and data safety
catalog.check.perf.recovery.why: Having a backup does not prove a restore works.
catalog.check.perf.recovery.limits: It proves only the declared scenario.
catalog.check.perf.compat.title: Compatibility
catalog.check.perf.compat.why: What is claimed to be supported must be tried.
catalog.check.perf.compat.limits: A sample does not prove every combination.
catalog.check.integ.guard.title: Integrity guard
catalog.check.integ.guard.why: Fixing by silencing raises the number and hides the problem.
catalog.check.integ.guard.limits: It detects the known patterns of silencing, skipping and changing references or thresholds, not every trick.
catalog.check.integ.state.title: State stability during the scan
catalog.check.integ.state.why: Results measured on two different states do not add up.
catalog.check.integ.state.limits: It sees what changed, not who changed it.
catalog.check.integ.model-claims.title: Matching model claims
catalog.check.integ.model-claims.why: What a model says is not evidence.
catalog.check.integ.model-claims.limits: Matching finds the corresponding check when there is one, and does not judge what has none.
catalog.check.integ.reviews.title: Validity of human reviews
catalog.check.integ.reviews.why: An old review of a scope that changed is not a decision.
catalog.check.integ.reviews.limits: It does not judge the quality of the review.
catalog.check.custom.any.title: Custom check
catalog.check.custom.any.why: Checks specific to this project that the catalog does not know.
catalog.check.custom.any.limits: AYAR does not know what the command means, and all custom checks count as one criterion in the index.
catalog.ai.logic-review.title: Logic review
catalog.ai.logic-review.role: What an unwritten test cannot catch: edge cases and business logic.
catalog.ai.threat-review.title: Threat review
catalog.ai.threat-review.role: Patterns do not reveal design flaws.
catalog.ai.docs-consistency.title: Documentation consistency
catalog.ai.docs-consistency.role: A README that describes what the project does not do.
catalog.ai.ui-copy.title: UI copy and terminology review
catalog.ai.test-gaps.title: Test gaps against behavior
catalog.ai.test-gaps.role: The inventory counts tests without understanding them.
catalog.ai.structure-review.title: Project structure review
catalog.ai.structure-review.role: Maintainability signals are numbers without an explanation.

catalog.redaction.exception.TERM_SESSION: The macOS Terminal session identifier, not a secret.

catalog.check.design.tokens.static.prove: Every value in the style files is on the token scale ({files} files)
catalog.check.design.tokens.render.prove: The computed values in the rendered pages match the tokens
catalog.check.design.fonts.static.proves: Every declared font is approved and its files exist ({files} files)
catalog.check.design.fonts.render.proves: The approved fonts are the ones actually loaded in rendering
catalog.check.design.a11y.proves: No automated accessibility violation (WCAG A and AA with axe) in the rendered states
catalog.check.design.a11y.review.proves: The human accessibility review is recorded and still holds
catalog.check.design.rtl.static.proves: Direction and language attributes and logical properties are sound in the source ({files} files)
catalog.check.design.rtl.render.proves: Rendering in Arabic respects the direction in the measured states
catalog.check.design.states.proves: Every defined UI state meets its expectation
catalog.check.design.visual.proves: The captures match the approved reference images
catalog.check.sec.secrets.history.proves: No secrets in the checked repository history
catalog.check.sec.deps.proves: No known vulnerability in the pinned dependencies against the local vulnerability database
catalog.check.sec.deps.audit.proves: No known vulnerability in the dependencies through the package registry
catalog.check.sec.sast.proves: None of the forbidden patterns in the code ({files} files)
catalog.check.sec.ext.manifest.proves: The manifest is sound: keys, files, messages and content policy
catalog.check.sec.ext.permissions.proves: Every requested permission is named in the permissions policy
catalog.check.code.build.proves: The build succeeds and the declared outputs exist
catalog.check.code.types.proves: No type error in the code ({files} files)
catalog.check.code.lint.proves: No error from the linter rules ({files} files)
catalog.check.code.refs.local.proves: Every local reference (file or anchor) points at something that exists ({files} files)
catalog.check.code.size.proves: The output sizes are within their declared budgets
catalog.check.code.complexity.proves: Complexity and function length were measured ({files} files); no verdict
catalog.check.beh.ext.host.proves: The extension loads in the browser with no console error
catalog.check.beh.stability.proves: The result is stable across the repeated attempts
catalog.check.beh.mutation.proves: The mutation score is at or above the declared threshold
catalog.check.perf.web.proves: The web metrics are within the declared budgets
catalog.check.perf.recovery.proves: The migration and recovery rehearsal succeeded with the declared command
catalog.check.integ.guard.proves: No suppression, skip or reference change since the base
catalog.check.integ.state.proves: No source file changed during the scan
catalog.check.integ.model-claims.proves: Every model claim was proven locally or decided
catalog.check.custom.any.proves: The declared success criterion of the custom check held
catalog.rule.analysis.unparsable-file.im: A file the tool could not read, so it was not checked; it may hold a violation you do not see.
catalog.rule.tokens.off-scale.impact: A value off the token scale breaks the design’s consistency and makes theming harder later.
catalog.rule.tokens.undefined-var.impact: An undefined CSS variable: the browser falls back to its default and the UI renders unlike its design.
catalog.rule.tokens.use-token.impact: A literal value that could be a token; a suggestion that does not change the result.
catalog.rule.tokens.render-off-scale.imp: The rendered value differs from the token, so what the user sees is not what the design files say.
catalog.rule.fonts.unapproved.impact: An unapproved font in the UI breaks the identity and may be missing on users’ devices.
catalog.rule.fonts.face-missing.impact: A declared font file does not exist: the browser silently falls back to another font.
catalog.rule.fonts.remote.impact: A font loaded from an external host: it reports users’ visits to a third party and ties rendering to the network.
catalog.rule.fonts.not-loaded.impact: The approved font did not load in rendering, so the UI appeared in a fallback font.
catalog.rule.a11y.violation.impact: An accessibility barrier that keeps screen-reader or keyboard users from completing the task.
catalog.rule.a11y.incomplete.impact: An item the accessibility tool could not decide; it needs your look.
catalog.rule.review.pending.impact: Accessibility is not recorded as met until a human reviews it: the tool alone is not enough.
catalog.rule.rtl.missing-dir.impact: A missing direction attribute renders Arabic left-to-right, mixing punctuation and numbers.
catalog.rule.rtl.missing-lang.impact: A missing language attribute denies screen readers correct pronunciation and disables font shaping.
catalog.rule.rtl.physical-property.impac: A physical (left/right) property instead of a logical one flips in the other direction; a suggestion.
catalog.rule.rtl.render.impact: The actual Arabic rendering breaks the expected direction or alignment.
catalog.rule.states.expectation-failed.i: A UI state does not meet its written expectation: what the user sees in that state is not what you decided.
catalog.rule.visual.diff.impact: A visual change from the approved reference image: intended or a regression, only your look decides.
catalog.rule.secret.detected.impact: A secret in the repository that anyone with the code can use in your name; it must be rotated, not just removed.
catalog.rule.secret.possible.impact: Text that looks like a secret; if real it is exposed, if an example you can exclude it by review.
catalog.rule.vuln.known.impact: A dependency with a known, published vulnerability exposes your project to a documented exploit.
catalog.rule.ayar.js.eval-dynamic.impact: Executing text as code lets untrusted input run anything inside your app.
catalog.rule.ayar.js.function-constructo: Building a function from text is dynamic code execution with the same effect.
catalog.rule.ayar.js.html-injection.impa: Inserting HTML from untrusted text opens the door to script injection in the user’s page.
catalog.rule.ayar.js.react-dangerous-htm: Passing raw HTML to React bypasses its injection protection.
catalog.rule.ayar.js.child-process-shell: Running a command through the shell with composed text allows OS command injection.
catalog.rule.ayar.js.tls-reject-unauthor: Disabling TLS certificate verification allows the connection to be intercepted and read.
catalog.rule.ayar.js.node-tls-env.impact: An environment variable that disables TLS verification for every connection of the process.
catalog.rule.ayar.py.eval-dynamic.impact: Executing text as Python code lets untrusted input run anything.
catalog.rule.ayar.py.subprocess-shell-tr: Starting a process through the shell with composed text allows OS command injection.
catalog.rule.ayar.py.os-system-dynamic.i: os.system with dynamic text allows OS command injection.
catalog.rule.ayar.py.tls-verify-disabled: Disabling TLS verification allows the connection to be intercepted.
catalog.rule.ayar.py.pickle-load.impact: Loading a pickle from an untrusted source executes code on read.
catalog.rule.ayar.py.yaml-unsafe-load.im: Unsafe YAML loading may build objects that execute code.
catalog.rule.sast.project-rule.impact: A violation of a Semgrep rule your project itself declares.
catalog.rule.manifest.missing-key.impact: A mandatory manifest key is missing, so the browser refuses to load the extension.
catalog.rule.manifest.invalid-version.im: An invalid manifest version prevents loading or publishing.
catalog.rule.manifest.missing-file.impac: The manifest names a file that does not exist, so the extension fails to load or loses a part.
catalog.rule.manifest.missing-default-lo: Localized messages with no default locale: the browser refuses the extension.
An undefined __MSG_ message shows the user raw text.
catalog.rule.manifest.csp-unsafe-eval.im: A content policy allowing unsafe-eval opens the extension to injected code execution.
A content policy allowing a remote script moves the extension’s behaviour to an external server.
catalog.rule.manifest.comments.impact: Comments in the manifest JSON may be refused by some browsers or publishing tools.
catalog.rule.manifest.mv2-chrome.impact: Manifest V2 is no longer supported in Chrome, so the extension will stop.
catalog.rule.permission.outside-policy.i: A requested permission your policy does not mention: the user cannot know why the extension needs it.
catalog.rule.permission.broad-unjustifie: A broad permission with no justification in the policy lets the extension do more than it needs.
catalog.rule.permission.maybe-unused.imp: A permission that may be unused; a suggestion to narrow it.
catalog.rule.build.failed.impact: The build fails, so nothing reaches the user.
catalog.rule.build.output-missing.impact: The build finished without its declared outputs, so what ships is incomplete.
catalog.rule.types.error.impact: A type error means code that may behave unlike you intend at run time.
catalog.rule.lint.error.impact: A violation of a rule your project declares; often a latent defect or hard-to-maintain code.
catalog.rule.lint.warning.impact: A linter warning that does not fail the check but points at something worth a look.
catalog.rule.unused.unlisted.impact: A dependency used but not declared: it works by chance and breaks when the dependency tree changes.
catalog.rule.unused.unresolved.impact: An import that resolves to nothing, so it fails at run time.
catalog.rule.unused.item.impact: An unused export or file that adds size and complexity; a suspicion.
catalog.rule.ref.missing-file.impact: A link or reference to a file that does not exist, so the reader lands on nothing.
catalog.rule.ref.missing-anchor.impact: A link to a heading that is not in the page, so the reader opens it at the wrong place.
catalog.rule.link.broken.impact: A broken external link leads the reader to an error.
catalog.rule.link.unverified.impact: A link the tool could not verify (refused or rate-limited); it needs your look.
catalog.rule.size.over-budget.impact: An output over its budget slows loading for users.
catalog.rule.size.info.impact: The output size, for information; no verdict.
catalog.rule.complexity.cyclomatic.impac: A function over the declared complexity threshold is hard to test and to change safely; a refactoring suggestion.
catalog.rule.complexity.length.impact: A function longer than the declared threshold; a suggestion to split it.
catalog.rule.test.failed.impact: A failing test: a written expectation did not hold, so either a defect in the code or a wrong expectation.
catalog.rule.test.collection-error.impac: A test file failed to load, so its tests did not run and may hide failures.
catalog.rule.test.snapshot-missing.impac: A missing test snapshot: the test compares against nothing.
catalog.rule.test.flaky.impact: A test whose result flips between attempts is evidence of nothing.
catalog.rule.test.warnings.impact: Warnings during the tests point at what may turn into a failure.
catalog.rule.ext.load-failed.impact: The browser refused to load the extension, so it will not work for the user.
catalog.rule.ext.console-error.impact: A console error while the extension runs means a part of it does not work.
catalog.rule.mutant.survived.impact: A mutation in the code no test detected: the assertions do not protect this behaviour.
catalog.rule.mutation.score-below.impact: The mutation score is below the declared threshold: the tests are weaker than you decided.
catalog.rule.perf.budget-exceeded.impact: A web metric over its budget means a slower experience than you decided.
catalog.rule.load.threshold.impact: A load-test threshold did not hold: the service cannot carry the declared load.
catalog.rule.custom.failed.impact: A custom check you declared failed by its own criterion.
catalog.rule.guard.silenced-rule.impact: A rule was silenced by a comment or an exception since the base: the number rose without a fix, so it does not count until you review it.
catalog.rule.guard.skipped-test.impact: A test was skipped or deleted since the base: an earlier failure vanished without a fix, so it does not count until you review it.
catalog.rule.guard.snapshot-changed.impa: A test snapshot changed since the base: the expectation may be what changed, not the code.
catalog.rule.guard.threshold-lowered.imp: A threshold was lowered since the base: the check passes by a lower bar than you decided.
catalog.rule.guard.reference-changed.imp: An approved reference or an AYAR file changed since the base, so the pass does not count until you review it.
catalog.rule.state.changed.impact: A file changed during the scan: the results were measured on two states and cannot be combined.
catalog.rule.claim.unproven.impact: A model claim no local check proved and you have not decided: it stays a claim and keeps the verdict away from "pure".
catalog.rule.review.expired.impact: A recorded review whose scope files changed, so its decision no longer holds.
catalog.rule.ref.missing-file.fix: Create the referenced file at the named path, or correct the link to point at the existing file.
catalog.rule.ref.missing-anchor.fix: Correct the anchor to match an existing heading in the target page, or add the heading.
catalog.rule.link.broken.fix: Update the link to an address that responds, or remove it if it has no counterpart any more.
catalog.rule.manifest.missing-file.fix: Add the file the manifest names at the named path, or correct the path in the manifest.
catalog.rule.manifest.missing-key.fix: Add the mandatory key to the manifest with a valid value.
catalog.rule.manifest.invalid-version.fi: Make the version field dot-separated integers (up to four parts).
catalog.rule.manifest.missing-default-lo: Add default_locale to the manifest with the language whose messages the _locales folder holds.
Define the named message in messages.json for every locale, or correct its name in the manifest.
catalog.rule.manifest.csp-unsafe-eval.fi: Remove unsafe-eval from the content policy and replace dynamic execution with static code.
